common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

home.tagline: Your recipes, your menus and your shopping list, shared with the people you love, right from your favourite AI assistant.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Your Kitchen account is created with Google. You can then add a passkey to sign in without Google.

account.title: My account
account.noHousehold: You do not belong to a household yet. Create one, or ask a member for an invitation link.
account.inviteLink: Send this link to the person you invite. It works once, until {{date}}.
account.passkeyIntro: A passkey lets you sign in on this device without Google.
account.passkeyAdded: Passkey added. You can now sign in with it.
account.passkeyUnsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
account.passkeyFailed: The passkey could not be added.
account.healthDataOff: Kitchen does not store your allergies and intolerances. If you allow it, they are visible to the other members of your household and to their AIs, so that household menus are safe for you.
account.healthDataOn: Kitchen stores your allergies and intolerances, and shares them with the other members of your household and their AIs.
account.signOutFailed: Sign-out failed: you are still signed in. Try again.

join.title: Join a household
join.intro: You have been invited to join a household on Kitchen.
join.notFound: This invitation is invalid, already used or expired.
join.alreadyInHousehold: You already belong to a household.

consent.title: Connect an AI
consent.intro: {{client}} asks to access your Kitchen household: profiles, appliances, recipes, menus, shopping lists and pantry. It will be able to read and change them on your behalf.
consent.warning: Only continue if you are adding Kitchen to this AI yourself, right now.
consent.notFound: This connection request is invalid or has expired. Start again from your AI.
consent.healthData: Allow Kitchen to store my allergies and intolerances. These are health data: they will be visible to the other members of my household and to their AIs, so that household menus are safe for me. I can withdraw this consent at any time on my account page, which erases them.
consent.healthDataGiven: You allowed Kitchen to store your allergies and intolerances. You can withdraw this consent on your account page.

shoppingList.title: Shopping list
shoppingList.notFound: This shopping list does not exist, or belongs to another household.
shoppingList.signInFirst: Sign in to see your household's shopping list.

connect.title: Connect your AI
connect.intro: Add Kitchen as a connector in your AI assistant. It will then ask you to sign in to Kitchen and to allow access to your household.
connect.claudeHint: Claude opens the form already filled in: click Add, then sign in to Kitchen.
connect.chatgptHint: The address is copied. On the Plugins page, click +, then “Add custom MCP server”, and paste the address. Depending on your plan, the option may not be available.
connect.geminiHint: The address is copied. In Gemini, open Settings, Connected apps, then Add a custom app, and paste the address. Only available for some Gemini accounts.
